editorial:
Imagine a reality show where office workers and factory workers are thrown together in the woods to compete for bragging rights. That's the wild setup of this mockumentary. You follow a crew of zany characters as they pitch and film a game show called "Company Retreat" deep in New York's Adirondack Mountains. The white collar folks and blue collar folks clash right away, and the tension only grows as the stakes get higher. It feels like a mix of workplace comedy and survival show, with plenty of awkward moments and big personalities. The mockumentary style makes you feel like you're right there with the crew, watching everything unfold.

The acting is surprisingly natural, and the pacing keeps things moving without dragging. You'll laugh at the stereotypes being poked fun at, but the movie also has heart when it shows people dropping their guard. On the downside, some jokes land better than others, and a few characters feel a bit one-note. Still, if you enjoy mockumentaries like The Office or Best in Show, you'll have a good time. It's worth streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, renting on Apple TV, or grabbing the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the game show wraps up with an unexpected twist. The blue collar team wins the competition, but the real surprise comes when the mockumentary crew reveals they've been filming the whole process as a pitch for a network. The white collar boss, who seemed like the villain, actually helped fund the project to bring both sides together. Relationships that started as rivalries turn into genuine friendships. You see the workers leave the mountains with a new respect for each other, and the show gets picked up for a full season.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves mockumentaries and workplace comedies.
